name: rot_slip
description: Unit square rotated by 30 deg; slip on local t=0, symmetry on local s=1, Dirichlet on s=0 and t=1; variable mu; the slip/symmetry edges are not axis-aligned (u.n = 0 must use the true normal). Pressure up to a constant.

domain.map: x = s cos(theta) - t sin(theta), y = s sin(theta) + t cos(theta)

conventions.f: -div sigma_form - gamma grad div u (= -div sigma_form for these fields)
conventions.traction: g = sigma_form n, n the outward unit normal
conventions.grad_div: gamma (div u_h, div v); gamma in viscosity units, not scaled by mu
